summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming now adds background contribution energies when merging SimCalorimeterHits, and keeps whole hits if any contribution falls inside the time window, changing overlay output behaviour.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — k4SimDelphesAlg converts EDM4hep MCParticle times from ns to mm/c before Delphes, correcting production, track-vertex and calorimeter times for displaced particles in framework-based Delphes runs.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — k4SimDelphesAlg creates reco–MC links during conversion, so Gaudi-based Delphes outputs carry filled RecoMCLink collections pointing to the input GenParticles.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#452](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/452)** — Writer deletes store wrappers of collections registered through the legacy DataHandle or DataWrapper, removing a memory leak of about 1.8 kB per event seen in k4SimDelphesAlg jobs.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#417](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/417)** — The IDEA and CLD Delphes cards use RandomSeed 0, so each job draws a fresh detector-smearing seed rather than every production job repeating identical random sequences.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#414](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/414)** — The IDEA Delphes card is synced with upstream, adding dual-readout photon angular smearing and pointing, which requires Delphes 3.5.2pre02 or later; output writes JetDurhamN2 and GenMissingET (see also **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#415](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/415)**).

- **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — The ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap places each wheel's cells in a dedicated mother volume, cutting ddsim initialisation time up to threefold and peak memory by about 2 GB.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#672](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/672)** — ALLEGRO compact files install ECal barrel and endcap inner-face surfaces via DD4hep CaloFace plugins, letting tracking such as ConformalTracking extrapolate tracks to the calorimeter.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — GGTFTrackFinder drops its LibTorch dependency, enables ONNX Runtime graph optimizations and adds a configurable InferenceThreads property, substantially reducing track-finding CPU time and memory.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1080](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1080)** — Generated EDM doxygen documentation hides podio internal classes by default through a conditional PODIO_INTERNAL section, and downstream projects must opt in to keep them.
